{{Quote|About 10 minutes back I got an emergency call from my niece, and she needs help. I can't run out there, with my leg and all, but will you do it?|[[Huff Darklighter]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HD" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''niece''' of [[Huff Darklighter]]. She lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|From what I understand, she and others were kidnapped by some thugs earlier today. She helped the others escape, but she needs help herself.|Huff Darklighter, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HD" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Huff Darklighter's niece resided at the [[Darklighter estate]], on the planet Tatooine. During that time, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] began to capture people on Tatooine in order to sell them as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="SWG:HD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Huff Darklighter's niece was among a group of people kidnapped by [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's thugs]]. However, she quickly managed to escape with others and called her uncle for help with her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. Huff Darklighter soon dispatched a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to rescue the woman before Jabba's henchmen tracking her showed up. The spacer found the woman lost in the desert and escorted her back safely to the Darklighter estate. The woman was really shocked by this experience but she was able to explain the whole story to her uncle. Huff Darklighter later paid the spacer to eliminate the criminal leading Jabba's slaving ring.<ref name="SWG:HD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Huff Darklighter's niece was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Huff Darklighter's niece was present in the original release of the game, being part of the first version of the [[W:c:swg:Darklighter's Estate questline (pre-NGE)|Darklighter's Estate questline]].<ref name="SWG:HD" /> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> the [[W:c:swg:Darklighter's Estate questline|Darklighter's Estate questline]] was deeply revamped and Huff Darklighter's niece was removed from the game.<ref name="SWG:DE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Darklighter Estate|Tatooine}}</ref>

In the game, the woman was only identified as "Huff's Niece" and did not have a proper name.<ref name="SWG:HD" /> The only identified nieces of Huff Darklighter were the two [[Anya Darklighter|younger]] [[Rasca Darklighter|sisters]] of [[Gavin Darklighter]]. However, as they were still children at the time of the Battle of Yavin,<ref name="Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> Huff's niece from ''Star Wars Galaxies'' should be another Darklighter.
